descriptor_metadata.covariance: uniform area, exact polygon moments; aspect ratio = lambda_max/lambda_min
descriptor_metadata.clearance_obstacles: obstacle polygons and workspace exterior; NOT region boundaries
descriptor_metadata.mean_clearance_method: area-weighted triangle quadrature, 12^2 samples per fan triangle
descriptor_metadata.missing_clearance: null when original map geometry is unavailable
descriptor_metadata.conductance: sum of all geometric shared-boundary portal widths / perimeter; safe_degree and safe_conductance use only traversable graph edges
descriptor_metadata.traversability: original portal width * min(mean clearances), units m^2; not a safety certificate

review.reviewer: assistant visual digitization; approximate building envelopes

scene_model.obstacles: 28 manually traced visible building/roof blocks; approximate envelopes, not surveyed footprints
scene_model.free_space: All remaining space inside the visible campus crop is free by modelling assumption, including grass and trees.
scene_model.boundary: Approximate visible campus perimeter; upper part is clipped by the image, not the full campus boundary.
scene_model.start: Gate 1 near the school name label, approximate position inside campus

warnings: Geometry is reviewed image tracing, not a surveyed map or verified traversability.
Uniform scale assumes a top-down image with no perspective or nonuniform resize.
Mean clearance uses the repository's numerical quadrature; it is not an exact integral.
Safe portals use the repository's endpoint trimming rule; collision checking remains necessary.
SIMULATION METRES: normalized like research maps, not measured campus dimensions.
